## Founder / CEO summary
Skand Vijay is the founder of Protograms (world's first try-in feed for AI products; NVIDIA Inception; CMU Swartz Center) and founder and CEO of The ScopeMind. He is a founding engineer focused on 0→1 products, developer infrastructure, and agentic AI.

## Education
- Carnegie Mellon University (CMU), Heinz College — Master of Information Systems Management (MISM), GPA 3.81, Dean's List
- Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT) — Bachelor of Technology, Electronics and Communication Engineering, GPA 3.96
